Package jzelda.patterns

Class GameFacade

java.lang.Object
jzelda.patterns.GameFacade
public final class GameFacade extends Object
Facade that exposes the main infrastructure subsystems through a single object. Controllers and the model use it to access resources, audio and persistence without coupling themselves to file-system details.
